title.zh: Marvell宣布以全股票交易收购Lumentum，对价约1150亿美元
title.en: 美股光模块龙头Marvell宣布以全股票交易收购光芯片龙头Lumentum，对价约1150亿美元

current_state.zh: Marvell 以全股票方式收购 Lumentum（企业价值约 1150 亿美元，换股比例 4.500 股，溢价约 23.9%，股权分配 67/33）已宣布但尚未完成，目标为 2028 年上半年，尚待股东和监管批准；宣布后两家公司的盘前股价均转跌。
current_state.en: Marvell's all-stock acquisition of Lumentum (~$115B enterprise value, 4.500-share exchange ratio, ~23.9% premium, 67/33 ownership split) is announced but not closed, targeted for H1 2028 pending shareholder and regulatory approvals; premarket shares of both companies turned lower after the announcement.

updates.title_en: 美股光模块龙头Marvell宣布以全股票交易收购光芯片龙头Lumentum，对价约1150亿美元
updates.what_changed_zh: Marvell 已同意以全股票方式收购 Lumentum，交易价值约 1150 亿美元，合并双方的电/光互连与光子学能力，为 AI 基础设施打造全栈连接产品组合。
updates.what_changed_en: Marvell has agreed to acquire Lumentum in an all-stock deal valued at roughly $115 billion, combining their electrical/optical interconnect and photonics capabilities to build a full-stack connectivity portfolio for AI infrastructure.

updates.title_zh: 美股盘前MRVL LITE由涨约4%，现转跌近1%
updates.title_en: 美股盘前MRVL LITE由涨约4%，现转跌近1%
updates.what_changed_zh: 交易条款细节披露：Lumentum股东每股换4.500股Marvell普通股，隐含每股约1132美元、企业价值约1150亿美元，较10月28日未受影响收盘价溢价约23.9%；合并后Marvell股东持股约67%、Lumentum股东约33%；预计2028年上半年完成，仍需双方股东及监管批准；Matt Murphy留任CEO，Lumentum获三个董事席位。消息公布后两股盘前由涨约4%转为下跌，MRVL跌约0.7%、LITE跌超1.2%。
updates.what_changed_en: Deal terms disclosed: each Lumentum share converts into 4.500 Marvell shares, implying ~$1,132/share and ~$115B enterprise value, a ~23.9% premium to the unaffected Oct 28 close; post-close Marvell holders own ~67% and Lumentum holders ~33%; closing expected in H1 2028 subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals; Matt Murphy remains CEO and Lumentum gains three board seats. Premarket shares of both reversed early ~4% gains, with MRVL down ~0.7% and LITE down over 1.2%.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Marvell Technology agreed to acquire optical communications firm Lumentum in an all-stock deal implying roughly $115B enterprise value (~$1,132/share, 23.9% premium), with Marvell holders owning about 67% of the combined company; premarket shares of both reversed early gains, with MRVL down ~0.7% and LITE down over 1.2%.
